request: Create ONE miniature story vignette: the same adult couple from Image 1 walk hand in hand on a small beach scene derived from Image 2. All identities, facial features and hairstyles come from Image 1; do not import the blond woman or the other man from Image 2. Dress the pair in simple casual clothes for a beach walk. Use sand, the yellow beach net and low pale shoreline building as scene cues; keep the paper island compact and restrained. This is a fictional travel episode, not a record that these people took this trip. Show the pair in a three-quarter view so their faces remain visible enough to compare with the cafe vignette.
